repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a 15-minute (900,000 ms) sustained wait. The candidate uses a 1000 ms wrapper period and a threshold of 900 ticks, which corresponds to only 900,000 ms. However, the JoI execution model counts the initial state as tick 1. Therefore, the condition must be held for 900 ticks *after* the initial check, requiring a threshold of 901 to ensure the full 15 minutes have elapsed before the action fires. The evidence shows the action firing at 899,000 ms (900 ticks) instead of 900,000 ms (901 ticks).
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the hold threshold from 900 to 901. This ensures the script waits for 901 iterations of the 100 ms wrapper, totaling 901,000 ms of observation time, which correctly covers the 15-minute (900,000 ms) requirement when the initial state counts as the first tick.
